messages:
maria: heads-up — found a tokenization edge-case in rc build that causes OOM on long contexts. small patch ready. requesting late-patch exception for this RC (quiet window ends in 2h).

devon: can you summarize the risk? is this customer-facing or internal dev flows only?

maria: customer-facing — observed in 2 PROD-like tests for >8k tokens, OOM in the tokenizer step. crashes inference processes, so availability impact for long prompts. low-risk patch (pure tokenizer lib bump).

sam: late patch exceptions: we need artifact pin, smoke, canary plan, release-notes delta, and rollback plan. also confirm no infra changes.

maria: patch PR merged to rc branch, artifact built. details:
```
artifact: rc-2026-04-07-tokenizer-fix
version: rc-2026.1.3
sha256: abcd1234ef567890...
change: bump tokenizer to 2.4.1 (fix OOM on long inputs)
```
pin proposal: rc-2026.1.3

jen: SRE checklist — need KV warm plan & canary telemetry gates. define success criteria (errors < 0.5%, latency within 10% of baseline). if any of gates fail, auto rollback.

maria: proposed canary: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 20m -> 100% step. smoke tests pass locally and staging. smoke commands run: `make smoke && ./smoke/check_inference.sh`

deploy-bot: [automated] prereq checks: artifact uploaded, infra unchanged, canary route available. smoke: OK. staging smoke: OK.

devon: ops window conflict? ops-bot?

ops-bot: quiet window calendar shows a partially overlapping DB migration at 22:00 UTC; but that is read-only migration, no risk if we avoid the 22:00-22:30 slot. current RC window ends 23:59 UTC — we have a 30m safe margin if we start canary now.

sam: release-notes: add short entry under 'bug fixes' with rollback note. link: https://internal/docs/releases/rc-2026/delta-tokenizer

maria: recommended rollout command (ops approved):
```
/deploy promote rc-2026.1.3 --to prod --canary 5,25,100 --canary-intervals 10m,20m,10m --monitor gates:errors<0.5% latency<+10% --pin rc-2026.1.3
```

jen: rollback plan: immediate rollback to rc-2026.1.2 pinned artifact. if canary fails, auto-rollback triggered by deploy-bot. if partial fail post-100% we run gradual traffic shift back to rc-2026.1.2 and execute incident runbook ROLLBACK-1. Notify oncall@sre.

devon: confirm post-deploy observability dashboards: per-route latency, error-rate, token-cost, and memory RSS for inference hosts. add short eval prompt set to catch tokenization regressions.

maria: added eval suite: `evals/tokenizer_long_context.yml` — run at each canary step.

deploy-bot: initiating canary promote: step1 -> 5% traffic. smoke: OK. evals/tokenizer_long_context: OK. telemetry: errors 0.09% (baseline 0.08%), latency +3%.

jen: thumbs-up. continue to step2 when stable for full 10m.

maria: step2 -> 25% started.

deploy-bot: step2 results after 20m: errors 0.12%, latency +4.5%, memory RSS stable. evals OK.

sam: we are green; proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: promoting -> 100% traffic. final smoke: OK. release pinned to rc-2026.1.3.

maria: pushing release-notes update and changelog. pinging customer success to update impacted customers. :mailbox_with_mail:

jen: please watch dashboards for 30m post-promo. oncall alerted.

devon: noted. thanks all. great run. :tada:

maria: closing the late-patch exception, marking code-owner postmortem optional. will file a short post-deploy note in #postmortems with telemetry snapshot.

deploy-bot: [automated] promotion complete at 4923456835. artifact pinned: rc-2026.1.3. rollback target available: rc-2026.1.2.
